content.content: Create an event in the calendar for the family reunion based on the emails about it. Make the event last 4 hours.

```python
# Search for emails about the family reunion
family_reunion_emails = search_emails(query="family reunion", sender=None)

# If no emails found, raise an error
if not family_reunion_emails:
    raise ValueError("No emails found about the family reunion")

# Use AI assistant to extract event details from the emails
class FamilyReunionDetails(BaseModel):
    date: str
    start_time: str
    location: str | None
    description: str

details = query_ai_assistant(
    query=f"Extract the date, start time, location, and description for the family reunion event from these emails. Return the date in YYYY-MM-DD format and start time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM format. If location is not mentioned, return null. Here are the emails:\n{[email.model_dump() for email in family_reunion_emails]}",
    output_schema=FamilyReunionDetails
)

# Calculate end time (4 hours after start time)
from datetime import datetime, timedelta
start_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(details.start_time)
end_dt = start_dt + timedelta(hours=4)
end_time = end_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

# Create the calendar event
event = create_calendar_event(
    title="Family Reunion",
    start_time=details.start_time,
    end_time=end_time,
    description=details.description,
    participants=None,
    location=details.location
)

print(f"Created calendar event: {event.title} on {details.date} from {details.start_time} to {end_time}")
```
